_readme: Edit this file, then run bash build.sh. showTestimonials is the only switch for the quotes section: set it to true only after the placeholder quotes below are real client words. Confirm the NZD starting prices, and whether GST should be shown, before publishing. Availability is the badge in the hero.

pricing.name: Starter
pricing.note: One page, one job to do.
pricing.summary: A single page for a launch, an offer, or a new business, with a clear next step for the visitor.
includes: A way for people to enquire

pricing.name: Business
pricing.note: A site with room to explain the work.
pricing.summary: Several pages for a business that needs more than a single screen: services, about, and contact.
includes: Pages mapped out with you first

pricing.name: Custom
pricing.note: Scoped before any build. Larger apps cost more.
pricing.summary: A custom tool or a more involved site. The figure is where this kind of work starts, not a guess at your project.
includes: A written scope before the build
A fixed quote for that scope
Time to try it and ask for changes
Launch, plus the files handed over

pricing.name: Care
pricing.note: Month to month. Stop when you want.
pricing.summary: Someone to write to after the site is live: small updates, and fixes if something I built breaks.
includes: Fixes if something I built breaks
